children: SFC Market Surveillance Division Executive Director Leung Chung-yin said in a keynote speech at the fourth HKEX China Opportunities Forum that Hong Kong will push for the regular issuance of government bonds, according to Ming Pao.
He also said Hong Kong is studying the phased introduction of central counterparty clearing for bond repurchase transactions and the building of a dedicated settlement system.

title: SFC's Leung Says Hong Kong To Normalize Government Bond Issuance
